evidence_label_guide.已验证: 已通过脚本或真实数据直接验证（缺失索引重建、本地解析、Cloudflare 挑战等）
evidence_label_guide.部分验证: 依赖外部条件或用户输入，部分场景可验证（如需用户确认茄衣、或网页搜索后才能评分）
evidence_label_guide.推断: 未直接验证，基于推理（如 Python 缺失或站点不可达的降级行为）

capabilities: catalogue lookup by brand and model
catalogue lookup by brand and model

steps: Confirm the interpreter with python3 --version, expecting 3.8 or newer.
Install nothing else. All six scripts import only the standard library.
Run python3 scripts/check_environment.py and read the status field.
setup.verify: python3 scripts/check_environment.py exits 0 and reports ready or partial
setup.security: No package installation is required, and none should be added to satisfy this skill. The scripts are stdlib-only so that a clone runs as-is; a third-party dependency would be a supply-chain surface with no benefit.

degradation.capability: catalogue lookup by brand and model
degradation.fallback: Answer from the cached references only: storage-terms.md, production-curing.md, terroir.md, flavour-groups.md.
degradation.limitations: No vitola, ring gauge or leaf breakdown can be produced.
degradation.recovery: Install Python 3.8 or newer from the official site, then rerun scripts/check_environment.py.
degradation.stop_condition: Stop all lookup requests. Do not describe a cigar from memory.

degradation.fallback: None. The Chinese index is only readable through fetch_domestic.py.
degradation.limitations: 长城, 黄鹤楼, 王冠 and 泰山 cannot be resolved.
degradation.recovery: Install Python, rebuild the index, then retry.
degradation.stop_condition: Say the lookup tooling is unavailable rather than naming a domestic model.

degradation.fallback: None. fetch_rating.py is the only reader for these pages.
degradation.limitations: No published score can be retrieved.
degradation.stop_condition: Report no score available. Never estimate one.

degradation.fallback: Read the halfwheel date archive directly with the built-in web-fetch tool.
degradation.limitations: No script-side detection of the Cloudflare challenge, so a 403 may be mistaken for an empty page.
degradation.recovery: Install Python and use fetch_news.py, which explains the block instead of guessing.
degradation.stop_condition: Do not report 'no new releases' from a failed fetch.

capabilities: catalogue lookup by brand and model

steps: No account, key or token exists for any of the five sites, so there is nothing to configure.
Treat 403 from halfwheel as normal: it blocks scripted access deliberately.
setup.verify: check_environment.py --online reports HTTP 200 for Cigar Century and 200 or 403 for halfwheel
setup.security: Only five fixed hosts are contacted, all over HTTPS and all read-only. No credential is sent because none exists, and no retailer is ever contacted.

degradation.capability: catalogue lookup by brand and model
degradation.fallback: lookup.py exits 2 with the reason. Use the Chinese index or cached references instead.
degradation.limitations: Non-Chinese models cannot be confirmed; cached slugs resolve but their spec sheets cannot be refetched.
degradation.recovery: Retry later. build_index.py already retries a failed fetch once.
degradation.stop_condition: Never substitute a similarly named cigar. Return no match and say the source is down.

degradation.fallback: None. No other source covers the domestic brands.
degradation.limitations: Domestic models cannot be resolved at all.
degradation.recovery: Retry later, or rebuild the offline index when the site returns.
degradation.stop_condition: Say the source is unreachable. Do not answer domestic questions from memory.

degradation.trigger: No rating page found, or the page cannot be read
degradation.fallback: Quote the tasting block from a 雪茄 123 detail page, labelled as a tasting note rather than a blind-panel score.
degradation.user_input: the exact brand and model, so the search can be retried
degradation.limitations: A score that was never published cannot be found. No estimate, no average.
degradation.recovery: Rerun fetch_rating.py --find to regenerate the query, then search again.
degradation.stop_condition: Report no published rating. Never present a number that did not come from a page.

degradation.trigger: Always, from a script: halfwheel blocks scripted access
degradation.fallback: fetch_news.py returns status blocked with date-archive URLs; read https://halfwheel.com/date/YYYY/MM/DD/ with the built-in web-fetch tool.
degradation.limitations: No automated feed; each check costs one page fetch.
degradation.recovery: Nothing to recover: the blocked response is the documented path.
degradation.stop_condition: Never retry in a loop, and never route the site search through a script.

functional_degradations.capability: catalogue lookup by brand and model
functional_degradations.trigger: data/brands.txt missing, the normal state on a fresh clone because data/ is gitignored
functional_degradations.fallback: check_environment.py reports partial and names the missing index; storage, terminology and flavour-group answers continue from cached references.
functional_degradations.limitations: No lookup until the index is built. This is not the same as the cigar not existing.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: Do not report a missing match while the index is absent; say the catalogue is not built.

functional_degradations.fallback: check_environment.py reports partial; every other function keeps working.
functional_degradations.limitations: 长城, 黄鹤楼, 王冠 and 泰山 cannot be resolved.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: Do not answer a domestic question from a foreign catalogue; none of these models are listed there.

functional_degradations.fallback: All 329 Cigar Capitol entries are cached under references/, so these answers are unaffected.
functional_degradations.limitations: Terms outside the six cached categories need one live fetch and are unavailable offline.
functional_degradations.recovery: Reconnect and fetch the single slug from https://cigarcapitol.com/dictionary/<slug>/.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: If a term is neither cached nor in capitol-index.md, say it is not covered rather than paraphrasing something else.

functional_degradations.trigger: the Wrapper value is missing or ambiguous on the record being classified
functional_degradations.fallback: Show the wrapper-to-group table from flavour-groups.md and ask the user to confirm the wrapper, or to pick between the two candidate groups.
functional_degradations.user_input: the Wrapper field, or a photo of the band and cellophane
functional_degradations.limitations: Group and humidity cannot be assigned from the line name alone: a maduro in the name does not guarantee a maduro wrapper.
functional_degradations.recovery: Once the wrapper is known, re-map it and continue.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: Never place a cigar in a group by guessing its wrapper; the humidity that follows the group is a storage instruction, not a label.

functional_degradations.trigger: the web search returns no Cigar Aficionado rating page
functional_degradations.fallback: Quote a 雪茄 123 tasting block, clearly labelled as a tasting note and not a blind-panel score.
functional_degradations.limitations: Absence of a published score is common for new and domestic cigars; it does not mean the cigar is unreviewed elsewhere.
functional_degradations.recovery: Rerun fetch_rating.py --find with the confirmed model name and search again.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: Say no published rating was found. Do not estimate, average or recall a score.

functional_degradations.fallback: Read the date archive https://halfwheel.com/date/YYYY/MM/DD/ with the built-in web-fetch tool, starting from today and walking back.
functional_degradations.user_input: the rough date window asked about
functional_degradations.limitations: One page fetch per day examined; no keyword search is available because the site blocks scripted search.
functional_degradations.recovery: No recovery needed. The blocked status carries the archive URLs by design.
functional_degradations.stop_condition: Never claim 'nothing new' from a blocked script response.
